items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: But it was nice working with him.

ctx.x: Fast and beautiful swing. Just starved all the musicians over there. But it was nice working with him. And Henri Myer was the band leader along with John Darville, he's d trumpet players. He was here for the jazz festival.

Anyway, I played all over, all over with them. We played Switzerland, I mean Sweden, some parts of Sweden. All over Denmark. Then I went to Germany and played Hamburg and some more places. And I got a call to go to France to make a five day tour with Jo Jones, Milt Buckner, and T-Bone Walker. And I had made four days of this tour and I became ill. I had trouble with sinus.
